categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of corrugated cardboard and corrugated cardboard boxes. It produces corrugated base paper and various types of corrugated boxes, focusing on customized, order-based production. There are no separate business divisions as all products relate to corrugated packaging materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes patented technologies such as double-layer corrugated base paper and high-strength corrugated box manufacturing methods with clear printing surfaces. Production is based on order-made manufacturing tailored to customer specifications, emphasizing multi-variety and high-quality products. The company holds multiple domestic and overseas patents related to corrugated paper technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include packaging manufacturers (box makers) and end-users across industries such as agriculture (vegetables, fruits), food and beverage, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and logistics. The company serves approximately 600 corrugated base paper customers and 850 corrugated box customers, including sectors like home shopping, agricultural products, and industrial goods.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily domestic within South Korea, with production facilities located in Ansan and other regions. The market is largely domestic due to the nature of the product and high transportation costs, with minimal export activity limited to local exports. The company’s sales and production are concentrated in South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain by manufacturing corrugated base paper and converting it into corrugated boxes. It supplies base paper to box manufacturers and sells finished boxes directly to end-users, positioning itself as both a raw material producer and a packaging product supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing competitiveness in corrugated box sales, expanding product variety and quality, and developing new markets such as triple-wall corrugated pallets. The company focuses on risk management, human resource development, and operational efficiency. R&D efforts emphasize product innovation, quality improvement, and environmental certifications like ISO and FSC.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of corrugated base paper and corrugated boxes on a made-to-order basis. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales to domestic customers. Export sales exist but are minimal compared to domestic sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a top position in the domestic corrugated cardboard industry with a market share around 7.3% in 2022. Major competitors include Taelim Packaging and Sambo Paper, which have larger market shares. The industry is highly competitive with price and quality as key factors, and the company competes through product differentiation and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported annual sales of approximately 283.5 billion KRW, a 6.3% decrease from the previous year, and an operating profit of about 11.1 billion KRW, down 7%. Total assets stood at 2.21 trillion KRW with a low debt ratio of 26.7%, indicating strong financial health. The company has shown stable profitability and is focused on sustaining growth and improving operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized corrugated packaging solutions tailored to diverse customer needs, including specialized products like double-layer corrugated base paper and triple-wall pallets. It highlights product strength, clear printing quality, and environmental certifications as differentiators. The focus on order-based production and broad customer base in various industries supports its competitive edge.
